title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: This privacy policy describes the practices regarding the collection of personal data on this website. Your privacy is important to us.
sec1Text: We do not collect any personal data about you when you browse this site. There is no registration, collection of personal information, or other processes related to the collection of sensitive data.
sec2Text: Although this site does not actively collect your personal data, it is possible that certain navigation data, such as information related to the technical performance of the site (for example, IP address, browser type or errors) may be collected for site maintenance and improvement purposes.
sec3Title: 3. No use of cookies or third-party services
sec3Text: This site does not make use of cookies and does not share information with third-party services, which means no data is collected for advertising or tracking purposes.
sec4Text: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page, and you are encouraged to check this page regularly to stay informed of any changes.
